summary: All five story checks passed. The reader decides presence from manifest.files only and throws a build error naming the file when the file is missing, or its byte count or sha256 differs. Malformed lists fail as a whole with an "invalid sources.json" message. The page has one h1 and is static (`export const dynamic = 'error'`, and /data is prerendered). Missing schema, empty state and omitted-field paths all show Unavailable with a reason. The diff stayed within apps/web/app/data, components/sources-table*, and apps/web/tests/*, plus orchestration files (prd.json, progress.txt) that are outside the story's file list.

checks.evidence: ruff, mypy, eslint and tsc all passed (turbo 4/4 successful, lint and typecheck results replayed from cache).
pytest 404 passed. Web vitest 394 passed across 14 files (replayed from cache), including components/sources-table.test.tsx with 42 tests.
next build succeeded. The route table shows ○ /data (Static).
Smoke output ends with the line: web-smoke: GET / shows the mock banner... mock-0. The command exited without error.

checks.criterion: AC1: empty state when not listed; build error naming the file when listed but missing or sha256/bytes differ; malformed list renders no partial rows; synthetic test ids
checks.evidence: sources.ts:143-144 returns the NO_SOURCES reason when the manifest does not list the file. sources.ts:88-107 throws when the file is missing, or its byte count or sha256 differs. sources.ts:120-131 validates the list as a whole before returning rows. page.tsx:28-33 renders LabelledValue 'Unavailable' with the reason. Tests at sources-table.test.tsx:137-253 and 337-414 cover these cases.

checks.criterion: AC2: T7-owned reader validating with the ProductRecord schema; a missing schema gives Unavailable 'ProductRecord schema not in @terraluna/schema', no rows, and a code comment
checks.evidence: sources.ts:63-67 looks up ProductRecordSchema by export name and returns null when absent. sources.ts:155-157 returns the unavailable state with the exact reason. A code comment names the missing schema (sources.ts:58, 64). The reader lives in app/data, and no lib/bundle* or scripts/* file is touched.

checks.criterion: AC3: Bundle files table from manifest.json (path, sha256, bytes); no invented licence or attribution text
checks.evidence: BundleFilesTable (sources-table.tsx:115-148) renders the schema's file fields. page.tsx adds only headings. Test 'types no licence or attribution' covers this.

checks.criterion: AC4: Licences, attribution and checksums columns show Unavailable with a reason when omitted; no typed row text
checks.evidence: sources-table.tsx:54-67: undefined or null becomes LabelledValue 'Unavailable' with omittedReason(field). A non-text value throws instead of being formatted, and there is no zero coercion.

checks.criterion: AC5: /data static, one h1, typecheck and lint pass, web-smoke passes
checks.evidence: page.tsx:15 sets dynamic='error' and the single h1 is at line 24. The build shows /data as Static. make check and web-smoke passed.

findings.claim: The records path (a ProductRecordSchema export plus a listed sources.json) has no real end-to-end run, because the schema does not exist on this branch.
findings.evidence: productRecordSchema() returns null on this branch. The records path is covered only by injected-schema unit tests. Revisit once T1-01 and T15 land.
